skipped.reason: kz-ru instance (Kazakhstan, Russian names, 'EDC2024: EDP EAST EAST') exists in Egger's backend but is NOT in the public tool's valid-market list; querying it with the key from the JS bundle is not public-catalog data (licence risk). Kept separately in egger.json, not used here.

Public UI rejects kz-ru; since no '-ru' market is valid it redirects Kazakhstan/Russian visitors to gb-en (UK, 'EDC2026: WEST UK/IE', 365 decors: Eurodekor E05 P2 8/12/15/18/22/25/30/38 mm, P3, Flammex; UK-specific range, not used).
Redirects to /de/ — no Russian-language egger.com site.

Downloads list is rendered client-side; no static availability/'Lieferprogramm' PDF link found. The tool's PDF export is generated on demand (pdf-service.netural.com) and offered only for 23 markets (AT-DE, DE-DE, ... UA-UK, not KZ/RU); not used — same data as the tool.
P_EUROLIGHTDECOR (Eurolight lightweight board 38/50 mm), laminates, compacts, worktops, splashbacks are outside the ldsp/mdf/hdf scope and were not recorded.
